question: Should `workboard_decompose` retain its established omitted-argument behavior of completing the parent, with fail-closed completion available only through an explicit opt-in, or should the plugin intentionally change that default for all existing callers?
rationale: The patch changes a previously documented tool default and adds completion policy to a public Workboard contract; code review cannot determine whether breaking existing omitted-argument callers is the intended product policy.

options.title: Preserve the existing default
options.body: Keep omitted `completeParent` behavior compatible and require an explicit parameter or separately approved workflow for the stricter decomposition policy.

options.title: Adopt the new default
options.body: Approve leaving decomposed parents open by default, then document the breaking change and provide downstream consumer and upgrade evidence.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing default
recommendation.body: Keep omitted `completeParent` behavior compatible and require an explicit parameter or separately approved workflow for the stricter decomposition policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies this contributor as the only concrete participant in the proposed Workboard completion-policy change; confidence is low because current-main area ownership history could not be inspected.
